items.question: How far in advance should I enquire?
items.answer: As soon as you have your date and venue. Wedding dates fill up, and an early enquiry gives us time to plan your look properly.

items.question: Where do you work?
items.answer: Beauty by Nam is based in Leicester and covers Leicestershire and the East Midlands. Weddings elsewhere in the UK and destination weddings are considered by arrangement.

items.question: Will travel be charged?
items.answer: Yes. Travel is added to your quote as a separate line so you can see exactly what it covers. It depends on how far your venue is from Leicester.

items.question: Do you work with bridal parties?
items.answer: Yes. Tell me how many people need hair or makeup when you enquire, and your quote will reflect the time needed on the morning.

items.question: How do I secure my date?
items.answer: Once you accept your quote, a deposit secures the date. The full details are in the terms and conditions and on your quote.
